question: On exact 100-card V2 physical Ignus/Warp challenger libraries, how many current-turn Spawn triggers and targeted damage events come from a single source-paid hand Ignus with a supported legal MV1 cascade hit, under stax, countered-hit and nonhand-fetch cases; what relevant Keeper damage is relinquished in the provisional lead?

registered_cases.note: Conditional opponent counter after spell cast; trigger remains even if spell does not resolve

adversarial_condition: Rule of Law or Drannith prevents casting supported cascade hit; Keeper's targeted ability and Lost's Spawn only trigger on actual exile cast, not cascade alone. A successfully cast nonhand spell that is subsequently countered still triggered both.
primary_endpoint: actual cast-from-exile event and Lost Spawn creation, assessed with physical source and actual supported first cascade hit, not a generic cascade trigger count
opportunity_cost_endpoint: Keeper of Secrets causes targeted opponent damage equal to that cast spell's MV (1 for Sol Ring) when present, while Lost creates one Spawn; Keeper is absent from lead but present in comparable betrayal-cut portfolio
stop_rule: Execute seven predefined deterministic cases for both exact variants, with bounded existing physical zone fixtures; no Monte Carlo trials or broader opponent-policy simulation. If a case fails or a rules assumption is invalidated, stop and report rather than declare strategic superiority.
coverage_limitations: Only one physical first-hit Sol Ring is forced to library top for an adversarial conditional setup; not a randomly observed cascade-hit frequency.
Keeper targeted damage to one opponent from the resolved cast trigger, not damage per opponent; cannot claim aggregate three times mana value.
Lost trigger creates a virtual token tally; original library card-zone multiset is conserved and token is not an additional deck card.
Countered hit is an explicit post-cast opponent-response event, not executed as a full stack/combat simulator.
No whole-list current Oracle refresh, improved win rate or certified final deck.
fallback_decision: Retain both Keeper-cut and zero-MV-Betrayal-cut as live alternatives unless comparative effects and source access justify choosing; never upgrade stage to owner-ready based on this fixture alone.
